description: This file implements a Bootstrap datepicker plugin version 1.3.0, providing UI components for date selection, including native detection, calendar rendering, navigation, and keyboard controls.

classes.name: DatePicker
classes.description: Main class implementing the datepicker widget, handling UI rendering, user interaction, and date logic.

methods.name: detectNative
methods.description: Detects if the native HTML5 date input should be used based on user agent.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the datepicker UI components and event handlers.

methods.name: nav
methods.description: Creates navigation subcomponents for months and years.

methods.name: updateName
methods.description: Updates the display of month or year with animation.

methods.name: selectMonth
methods.description: Renders the days of a selected month and updates UI.

methods.name: selectDate
methods.description: Sets the selected date and updates the calendar view.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the input value with the selected date.

methods.name: keyHandler
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the datepicker.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a RFC3339 string.

methods.name: ahead
methods.description: Moves the calendar view ahead or behind by months and days.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Binds methods to the DatePicker instance for event handling.

methods.name: daysBetween
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between two dates.

methods.name: findClosest
methods.description: Finds the closest date with a specific day of the week.

methods.name: rangeStart
methods.description: Calculates the start date of the calendar view.

methods.name: rangeEnd
methods.description: Calculates the end date of the calendar view.
